source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Frame, p.2-6

procedures.title: Torque specifications: body mounts
notes: Figure 5 in the manual shows four Corvette body mount locations per side along the frame rails: #1 at the S-curve just behind the front wheel, #2 on the side rail at the front of the passenger compartment, #3 at the rear kick-up, #4 behind the rear wheel.
Mounts #1-#3 use a bolt from above through washer, upper cushion, frame bracket, lower cushion and retainer; #4 is stacked the other way, with its bolt inserted from below.
